subject: Borealis Labs onboarding: PO process, billing cadence, and early-pay request
messages:
From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@borealis-labs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Borealis Labs - supplier onboarding and payment terms

Hi Rachel / Monica,

Thanks for taking this — excited to get Borealis Labs set up as a Redwood supplier. We build lightweight monitoring agents and will deliver the first shipment of services starting Feb. To get started, please find attached our completed W9 and a supplier onboarding form (Borealis_W9.pdf, supplier_onboarding_form.pdf).

Couple of items we wanted to surface up front so your AP and procurement teams can evaluate:
- Preferred payment terms: Net 30 (standard for us).
- We can accept ACH or wire (ACH preferred).
- We'd like to ask about an early-pay option for the first three invoices: 2% discount if paid within 10 days. This helps us with implementation ramp costs.

Can you confirm Redwood's PO flow and what documents you need from our side to generate the PO? Also please confirm whether Net 30 is acceptable or if you require Net 45/60.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Oliver Chen
Head of Finance, Borealis Labs
oliver.chen@borealis-labs.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Borealis_W9.pdf (W9), supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (onboarding form)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@borealis-labs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Borealis Labs - supplier onboarding and payment terms

Hi Oliver — thanks for the docs and the clear summary. Looping in David from AP to confirm remit and payment mechanics.

Quick answers / next steps:
- We received your W9 + onboarding form; thanks.
- Redwood typically issues a PO before the first invoice. Our standard onboarding checklist is here (link in related_links) — I attached the one-page checklist for your convenience.
- Regarding terms: our default for new vendors is Net 45 to allow internal close alignment, but we do evaluate Net 30 for strategic partners. We also run an early-pay program that can be applied to select vendors — we can consider 2% within 10 days for a short initial window.

David — can you confirm what AP needs to enable ACH and whether the early-pay discount needs a contract amendment or can be handled administratively for the first three invoices?

Oliver — can you confirm the receiving remit name, bank details (for ACH), and whether invoices will reference a Redwood PO number when issued?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Attachment: onboarding-checklist-1p.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Borealis Labs early-pay pilot recommendation

Team,

I reviewed the Borealis onboarding form and W9. Short summary: vendor seems low-risk (US-based, small SOC2-lite controls, references OK). They requested Net 30 + 2% 10-day for first three invoices. Given our intake queue and the product need, I recommend we accept the early-pay request as a pilot (2%/10d for invoices 1–3) and set standard Net45 thereafter.

Rationale:
- The discount size is small; impact on unit economics is manageable for three invoices.
- Approving early-pay will speed their ramp and likely get first deliverables earlier.
- We can gate the pilot behind a PO and a short addendum to the master supplier terms (three-invoice clause).

Ask: David — can AP support the 2%/10d program administratively and create PO_123456 draft? Karthik — please review for any procurement policy flags.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Borealis Labs early-pay pilot recommendation

Monica — thanks. AP can support the early-pay pilot with these conditions:
1) We need a completed W9 (received) and bank details for ACH (vendor to provide).
2) Vendor must reference PO_123456 on invoices.
3) Legal must sign a short addendum (I can intake but will need Legal contact).
4) Early-pay will be processed via our dynamic discount workflow — we'll net the 2% on payment within 10 days; payments will still flow through our standard AR system.

I've attached a draft PO (PO_123456_draft.pdf) with Net45 as the default term and a clause on page 2 that authorizes the 2%/10d discount for the first three invoices once the addendum is signed. Please review the language and confirm if Legal needs changes.

Once we have the bank details + signed addendum, AP will issue the PO and onboard Borealis to the payment portal.

-David
David Kim
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_123456_draft.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@borealis-labs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Borealis Labs — PO issued and payment terms confirmed

Oliver — thanks for the fast replies and for sending bank details over yesterday. Legal signed the brief addendum and AP has issued the PO. Next steps below:

- PO: PO_123456 (attached: PO_123456_signed.pdf). Please include this PO number on all invoices.
- Payment terms: Net 45 (company default). However, as we discussed, Borealis is enrolled in an initial early-pay pilot: 2% discount if Redwood pays within 10 days for invoices 1–3 only. That discount is documented in the signed addendum attached to the PO.
- Remit: ACH to the bank account you provided; our AP team will run a validation batch before the first payment.
- Portal: We sent an onboarding invite to accounts@borealis-labs.com for our vendor portal — please complete the portal steps so invoice submission and 1099 reporting are automated.

Welcome aboard — looking forward to the kickoff. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff between your delivery lead and our SRE onboarding team later this week.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Head of Revenue Operations (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_123456_signed.pdf, onboarding-portal-invite.txt
